card.name: Words leading into birth-control or HPV details
card.fires_on: Short words and digits just before a specific detail in contraceptive or HPV label text, such as 'use' or 'to' in 'instructed to use a back-up method', or the digit in an HPV type number.

modes.label: Back-up contraception instruction
modes.description: Verbs and 'to' in advice to use a back-up birth control method.

modes.label: HPV type numbers and ages
modes.description: Digits or 'to' in HPV type numbers and vaccine age ranges.

modes.label: Dose or product number gaps
modes.description: A space or number slot before a dose or product strength.
